headline: Portugal lends at 2.93% versus 3.48% in the euro area, and the credit problem is not the interest rate
summary: Portuguese credit costs stand at 2.93% against 3.48% in the euro area, according to an Observador analysis. The article argues that housing affordability, not interest rates, is the core credit problem.
why: Mortgage and credit conditions shape household demand and banking sector lending volumes in the euro area.
